statsViewer.showProTools.description: Show the Export, Codebook and Crosstab buttons (Zovo Pro tools, 3 free tries each). Turn off to hide them.

walkthroughs.title: SPSS Viewer & Stata Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Open SPSS, Stata and SAS transport data files in VS Code, with value labels and summaries.

steps.title: Open a data file
steps.description:
Click any .sav, .zsav, .dta or .xpt file in the Explorer: it opens in the data grid. Scroll through millions of rows, sort by a column, filter, and copy cells.
[Open a sample SPSS file](command:statsViewer.openSample)
[Open a file...](command:statsViewer.open)

steps.title: Value labels and variables
steps.description:
The Value labels button switches between labels such as "Agree" and the codes behind them. The Variables tab lists every variable with its label, type, format, measure, missing values and value labels.
[Open a sample Stata file](command:statsViewer.openSample?%22dta%22)

steps.title: Summaries and frequencies
steps.description:
Click the sum sign in a column header for the count, missing values, mean, standard deviation, quartiles and the frequency table of that variable.
[Open a sample SPSS file](command:statsViewer.openSample)

steps.title: Files that often come with survey data
steps.description:
If your project also has spreadsheets and CSV files or SQLite databases, these free Zovo extensions open them. A link opens the extension page, and you choose there whether to install it.
[XLSX and CSV Viewer](command:extension.open?%5B%22zovo.table-viewer-vscode%22%5D)
[SQLite Viewer](command:extension.open?%5B%22zovo.sqlite-table-viewer%22%5D)
